scripts.dev: lsof -ti:3847 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .next; next dev --turbopack -p 3847
scripts.cf:preview: bun run cf:build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env preview
scripts.cf:upload:preview: bun run cf:build && opennextjs-cloudflare upload --env preview
scripts.cf:upload:production: bun run cf:build && opennextjs-cloudflare upload --env production
scripts.cf:deploy:preview: bun run cf:build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env preview
scripts.cf:deploy:production: bun run cf:build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env production
scripts.cf:typegen: bun run cf:typegen:preview && bun run cf:typegen:production
scripts.cf:typegen:preview: wrangler types worker-configuration.preview.d.ts --env preview --env-interface CloudflarePreviewEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.cf:typegen:production: wrangler types worker-configuration.production.d.ts --env production --env-interface CloudflareProductionEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.mcp:deploy: bun scripts/build-mcp-data.mjs && cd mcp-worker && bun run deploy
